<thought>Using the three required templates in order, I applied each retrosynthetic transformation to the target molecule (SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1). The first template (1914393) disconnects the amide‑linked triazine ring, giving a chloromethyl‑aryl chloride fragment and a triazine‑amine fragment. The second template (1914394) breaks the chloromethyl‑aryl chloride into a simple phenyl‑methanol precursor and a chloride source. The third template (1914395) then cleaves the phenyl‑methanol into anisole (the methoxy‑phenyl ring) and formaldehyde, completing the route. All steps are valid according to the templates, and each precursor is a commercially available simple building block.
